title: Tight turn off the boards
objective: Compare the passing lanes available after a described turn.
briefing: Navy attacks the +x end. YOU have the puck after a turn away from the boards. F1 is gold and is near the lane to teammate 2. Teammate 1 is in the middle. The earlier turn is described, not animated.
limits: Static practice scene. Any earlier action or hypothetical change is stated in words; speed and outcomes are not simulated.
prompt: After your turn, which passing lane is farther from F1?

options.text: The lane to teammate 1 through the middle
The lane to teammate 2 near the boards
Both lanes are equally far from F1

title: Pivot to close the gap
objective: Connect a described pivot with tracking the current puck threat.
briefing: Gold attacks the +x end, which Navy defends. YOU have just pivoted and are still on the net side of F1. F1 has the puck; F2 is behind F1 in the attack direction. The pivot is stated, not animated.

prompt: After your pivot, which threat should YOU track first here?

options.text: F1 carrying the puck toward your net
F2 trailing behind the puck
The space halfway between F1 and F2
